title: Fmr. LVMH Exec. Brown on Estée Comeback, Consumer Trends
summary: Pauline Brown, former chairman of LVMH North America, discussed evolving trends in the luxury market. She highlighted that while traditional luxury spending correlates with strong economic indicators like housing and low unemployment, today's consumers are more discerning. She speaks with Romaine Bostick & Sally Bakewell on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Bill Dudley Warns That US Stocks Are in Bubble Territory
summary: Bill Dudley, a Bloomberg Opinion columnist and former New York Fed President, explains why he thinks US the equity market is in bubble territory. Speaking with Romaine Bostick on "Bloomberg The Close," Dudley also comments on the economic impact of AI and the rise in bond yields. (Source: Bloomberg)
